name: Abendego's Squall (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

disable: DC 23 Medicine check (trained) to remove the harpoon, DC 21 Nature check (trained) to calm the orca, or DC 23 Intimidation check (trained) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
routine:
d Abendego's Squall thrashes against the hull of the Snapdragon. With each action, it makes a flipper Strike against a PC adjacent to the railing. Whenever it makes a flipper Strike, it also deals its Strike damage to the ship whether or not the Strike was successful.

---
Speed 30 feet

items.name: Thar She Blows
items.text:
Trigger Abendego's Squall matches speed with the Snapdragon

---
Effect The orca leaps across the Snapdragon and tears its main mast from the deck in the process. This deals 30 damage to the Snapdragon. All creatures on deck take 2d8 bludgeoning damage from the shrapnel and must attempt a DC 20 basic Reflex save save. Abendego's Squall rolls initiative.

text: A massive orca known as Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.
